entities.summary: Brandon Coupe is an American tennis coach and former professional player who is the associate head coach of the Stanford Cardinal men's tennis team. He enjoyed most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career, he won one doubles title. He achieved a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 62 in 1999.
